# Version 4.151.2
> **Engine and package servicing** · Released August 29, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.102/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.2 updates the m151 engine revision and separates its HarfBuzzSharp package revision line.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Same-milestone servicing** — Incorporates the upstream m151 servicing sync without managed API changes. ([#4692](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4692))

## Platform

- **Distinct HarfBuzzSharp package revision** — Uses HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.102 to avoid package-version collisions with independently serviced Skia milestones. Native HarfBuzz remains 14.2.1. ([#4832](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4832), [#4835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4835))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.102

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
